description_zh: Cruise AV 停在车道内，前方 GMC Yukon 斜停后开始倒车，撞到 AV 前部。核心机动为倒车（backing），属于 CARLA 无法实现且 NHTSA 非 V2V 子集，排除。
reason: 核心机动涉及倒车/后退（GMC Yukon reversing），命中淘汰规则1。

source_snippets: After the Cruise AV came to a complete stop, the GMC Yukon began reversing further into the Cruise AV’s lane and made contact with the Cruise AV
